expressions.name: lps_5_pct
expressions.expr: next(item['amount'] for item in extras['late_payment_lines'] if '5%' in item['description'])

expressions.name: lps_10_pct
expressions.expr: next(item['amount'] for item in extras['late_payment_lines'] if '10%' in item['description'])

expressions.name: summer_units
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug'])

expressions.name: winter_units
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Dec', 'Jan', 'Feb'])

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug']) - sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Dec', 'Jan', 'Feb'])

expressions.name: avg_monthly_bill
expressions.expr: sum(row['amount_billed'] for row in extras['billing_history_rows']) / len(extras['billing_history_rows'])
